description: Changes a list the signed-in shopper owns, by list_id: its title, who it is for (recipient) and the event date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only the fields given are changed; an empty recipient or event_date clears it. Requires sign-in.

event_date.description: The day the gifts are for, YYYY-MM-DD. Empty clears it.

market.description: Market for the links and prices in the answer: dk, se, de or no.

recipient.description: Who the list is for, e.g. a first name; up to 80 characters. Empty clears it.

title.description: New title, up to 80 characters; markup and links are removed.

name: update_my_wishlist
title: Rename or update my list
